themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts, research papers, or earnings calls, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content focusing on the creation or use of artificial users for research, testing, or simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Broadly covers articles about various AI-powered tools and platforms used for research across different domains.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles about AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on the application of AI in evaluating and improving the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in various aspects of design research, from ideation to analysis and implementation.

themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles detailing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Content related to AI's capability to analyze and understand user sentiment from feedback, reviews, and comments.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to derive actionable insights from customer data and interactions.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare different AI tools or evaluate their performance against established methods.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
